findings.title: Disclosure scopes filing-text quotes to guidance only, but the note now also cites balance-sheet and liquidity quotes
findings.detail: The last Disclosures bullet says figures are generated by code from SEC XBRL data '(and, for guidance, from verbatim filing quotes)'. The round-2 note also cites non-guidance filing-text figures through [[Q-11]] (marketable debt securities 34,143), [[Q-12]] (marketable equity securities 42,783) and [[Q-13]] ($56.6bn / $42.8bn liquidity), all from periodic.txt, and it reports analyst offline results (target sensitivity, 'about two percentage points', WACC thresholds). Those offline results are labelled Judgment and 'analyst's offline check' in the body, so nothing is mislabelled there. The parenthetical in the disclosure is just narrower than what the note actually uses. The quotes are verbatim (they pass the gate) and the figures are correct, so this is minor.
findings.required_evidence: Disclosure reads e.g. '(and, for guidance and the marketable-securities balances, from verbatim filing quotes)', or otherwise covers non-guidance quotes.

resolved.evidence: The Model and valuation 'Judgment (net cash)' paragraph now cites [[Q-13]] ($56.6bn cash, equivalents and marketable debt securities; $42.8bn marketable equity securities), [[Q-11]] (34,143) and [[Q-12]] (42,783), noting they come from the filing and are in millions with the current period first (matches the balance-sheet header 'Jul 26, 2026 | Jan 25, 2026', periodic.txt line 255). It states that upside stays below -10% in every case and that the margin to the Neutral edge narrows to about 2pp at most. I re-ran this independently with src/aicfinal/valuation.dcf and the code's blending formula at WACC 10.7%. Code net cash gives blended 181.53, TP 182, -13.2%. Adding debt securities gives 182.94, TP 183, -12.7%. Debt securities plus equity at a 30% haircut gives 184.17, TP 184, -12.2%. Both lines at full value give 184.70, TP 185, -11.8%, which is 1.8pp from the band edge. The claim holds.

The note now says the net cash figure 'deducts total debt (short-term plus long-term debt)'. That matches mapping total_debt = LongTermDebt 33,366m = short-term debt 1,000 + long-term debt 32,366 (periodic.txt lines 299, 303) and valuation.json debt = 33,366,000,000.
